name: WorldFront ⚔️
desc:
🌍⚔️ Welcome to WorldFront!

Expand your nation, conquer territory, and fight for control of the entire world! Build your army, defend your borders, form alliances, and outsmart other players to become the strongest nation on the map. 🔥

How to Play:
🌍 Expand your territory
⚔️ Attack and conquer other nations
🪖 Grow your army and manage your troops
💰 Build your economy and earn more resources
🏙️ Build cities and strengthen your nation
🤝 Form alliances with other players
🚢 Launch naval invasions and control the seas
🛡️ Defend your borders from enemy attacks
🚀 Use powerful weapons in late-game wars
🏆 Control the world and become the ultimate superpower!

Will you build a powerful empire... or be wiped off the map? 👀

🎮 Supports Desktop, Console, Mobile, and Tablet players

llm.loop: spawn as a nation on a world map -> expand territory and grow troops -> attack, ally, invade by sea -> nukes late game
llm.instructions: expand, attack, build cities, form alliances, launch nukes
llm.thumbnails: world map with player nation labels and troop counts
llm.complexity_notes: world map territory sim for 100 players
